general.what food is this?: This is a sunny side up egg.
general.what are the ingredients?:
You will need: 
 • Eggs 
 • Oil 
 • Salt 
 • Pepper.
general.how to make it?:
1. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat. 
2. Add the oil to the skillet and let it heat up. 
3. Crack the eggs gently into the skillet, ensuring the yolks remain intact. 
4. Cook the eggs for about 2-3 minutes, until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny. 
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste. 
6. Carefully slide a spatula under the eggs and transfer them to a plate. 
7. Serve immediately and enjoy!
general.identify this food: This is a classic Mediterranean salad with feta, olives, and cucumbers.
general.give me the recipe:
Ingredients 📝: 
 
 Cherry tomatoes 
 • Cucumbers 
 • Red onion 
 • Feta cheese 
 • Kalamata olives 
 • Olive oil 
 • Oregano 
 
 Recipe 📒: 
 
1. Wash all vegetables thoroughly under cold water. 
2. Slice the cherry tomatoes in half and place them in a large mixing bowl. 
3. Peel the cucumbers (if desired) and chop them into bite-sized pieces. 
4. Thinly slice the red onion and add it to the bowl. 
5. Crumble the feta cheese over the top of the vegetables. 
6. Add the Kalamata olives, either whole or halved, depending on your preference. 
7. In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil and oregano to make a dressing. 
8. Drizzle the dressing over the salad ingredients. 
9. Gently toss everything together until well combined, being careful not to break the feta too much. 
10. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if desired.
11. Serve immediately and enjoy your fresh Mediterranean salad!
